bundle.shortDescription: Route Windows system audio to multiple outputs (developer preview)
bundle.longDescription: SyncSound captures Windows audio with WASAPI loopback and plays it on several output devices at once, with per-output gain, mute, delay and estimated latency alignment. Latency figures are estimates from Windows-reported buffers; acoustic calibration is not included in v0.1.
